verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official CLI, ykman (YubiKey Manager), documented on its developer site as the way to configure a YubiKey from the command line. A runtime probe confirmed it installs keylessly from public registries, reports version 5.9.2, and offers scriptable device management across applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or agent-oriented usage guidance for the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Configure your YubiKey via the command line.
Yubico's official ykman CLI installs keylessly from public registries and identifies itself
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
